Who we are

Inclusion is not a special service. It is how every service should work.

Holistic Disability Development Organization is an Ethiopian local non-governmental and non-profit organization. We exist to promote the rights, dignity and full inclusion of persons with disabilities.

Starting in the Somali Region and working across Ethiopia, HDDO brings disability inclusion into education, health, livelihoods, humanitarian action and community development.

Rights firstEqual dignity, participation and opportunity.
Led locallySolutions shaped with communities and OPDs.
Built to lastPractical systems, skills and partnerships.
Accountable learningEvidence that improves our work.
Our vision

An Ethiopia where every person can participate fully.

Our mission: To empower persons with disabilities through inclusive education, accessible health services, sustainable livelihoods, humanitarian assistance, disability rights and community-based inclusive development.

We build partnerships with government institutions, Organizations of Persons with Disabilities, civil society, UN agencies, academic institutions, development partners and the private sector.

How we create change

Programs designed around real life.

Each program is connected to the wider conditions that enable people to learn, earn, access services and lead in their communities.

Why inclusion matters

When barriers fall, communities become stronger.

Disability inclusion is not separate from development. It improves the systems that all people rely on, from a clinic and classroom to a market, water point or emergency response.

01Better access to quality education and healthcare
02More independent livelihoods and economic opportunity
03Communities that are safer, more resilient and equitable
